test_title: SSC CGL 2023 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 17 Jul 2023 Shift 4)
subject: general
question: **Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word. **
solution: The incorrectly spelt word is: **Prophane** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The correct spelling is "**Profane**" which means showing disrespect for something sacred or religious. (किसी पवित्र या धार्मिक चीज़ के प्रति अनादर दिखाना) • **For example**: *Using profane language in a formal setting is considered impolite and inappropriate.* • The incorrect spelling "**Prophane**" does not exist in the English language. • This is an example of a spelling error. Therefore, the correct answer is **option 4**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** • **Reasonable **is spelt correctly which means fair and sensible. (निष्पक्ष और समझदार) • **Laughable **is spelt correctly which means ridiculous or amusing. (हास्यास्पद या मनोरंजक) • **Blessed **is spelt correctly which means having divine favour or protection. (दैवीय कृपा या सुरक्षा होना) 1d9:Tb72, The correct answer is: **Saga**
